description: Rug Doctor Deep Carpet Cleaner delivers professional-grade carpet cleaning in the convenience of an upright machine. Simply pull backward on the handle to reveal immediate results. The only deep carpet cleaning machine of its kind with dual, cross-action scrubbing brushes, the machine’s bristles rotate and oscillate to scrub carpet fibers from every angle lifting away worked-in dirt and stains to leave behind clean, soft carpet. Rug Doctor‘s powerful suction, 75 percent more than other leading cleaners, leaves behind less wetness for faster drying times. Clear clean and dirty water tanks with simple lift technology makes it easy to see when it’s time to empty and refill with no mess. Larger opening lids allow for easy filling and rinsing, and a convenient built-in soap measure cap makes the machine a breeze to operate. Customize the level of clean for different areas of the home with a turn of the Super Boost dial. No assembly required--ready to clean and go to work straight out of the box.
